summary: Marketing coordinator who plans campaigns from first draft to final report, with a habit of testing two versions of everything.

workExperienceSection.workDescription:
• Plan and run email and social campaigns for 8 clients, with budgets from $5,000 to $60,000 a quarter
• Grew a regional bakery client’s newsletter from 2,000 to 11,000 subscribers in a year by testing subject lines every week
• Write the monthly results report for each client and present it with the account manager

• Posted daily to Instagram and TikTok and doubled followers to 18,000 in nine months
• Started a customer photo series that became the shop’s most shared posts
• Helped plan the summer concert series promotion, including flyers, radio spots and a partner email list of 40 local businesses
